target.title: fix(local-container): guard Cleanup orphan sweep against a concurrent same-scope Acquire's claim
target.body:
## Summary
Guards the `local-container` provider's `Cleanup` against a cross-process TOCTOU race that deletes a
concurrent crabbox run's **live** lease claim. `(*backend).Cleanup` snapshots containers via
`listContainers()` **before** it reads lease claims via `core.ListLeaseClaims()`, then its orphan sweep
removes — via the **unguarded** `core.RemoveLeaseClaim` — any provider claim on the current
runtime/context/host scope that is absent from that stale container view. A claim registered by a
concurrent `Acquire` on the **same scope** (a second `crabbox` run against the same docker context on the
same host) for a live container is visible to the newer claim read but absent from the older container
view, so it is swept as "missing container" and that live lease's claim is destroyed. The trigger is two
concurrent same-scope `crabbox` runs; no attacker.

Part of https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1144. Same `[security]` destructive-cleanup class
already hardened in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1124 (tart),
https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/446 (aws/azure), and
https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/781 (freestyle/islo); sibling to the apple-container fix
https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1146.

## What to review
| file | change |
|---|---|
| `internal/providers/localcontainer/backend.go` | +27 / −7 — snapshot claims before listing containers; guard the orphan-sweep removal with `RemoveLeaseClaimIfUnchangedAfter`, removing the stored key inside the same claim-lock fence for a confirmed orphan |
| `internal/providers/localcontainer/cleanup_toctou_test.go` | +228 — two regression tests (fresh-claim + reclaim), scope-forced, base-fails / HEAD-passes |

## How it works
Mirrors the merged tart fix (https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1124):
- Snapshot orphan-candidate claims **before** `listContainers()`, so a claim newer than the container
  view cannot be misclassified as a "missing container" orphan.
- Guard the sweep removal with `core.RemoveLeaseClaimIfUnchanged`, so a lease reclaimed mid-cleanup is
  spared.
- A genuine orphan still has its claim **and** its stored testbox key removed, preserving the existing
  `TestCleanupRemovesStaleLegacyUnscopedClaimWithoutContainer` behaviour — the key removal now runs *inside*
  the same claim-lock fence via `core.RemoveLeaseClaimIfUnchangedAfter` (it runs the action, then removes
  the claim, all under the per-claim lock), so a same-lease reclaim landing mid-cleanup keeps both its
  claim and its key.

**Scope note:** local-container's sweep is scope-filtered (`localContainerClaimMatchesScope`), so the race
is gated to two runs sharing the same docker runtime/context/host — the normal same-machine case. The
regression tests force a non-empty scope (via a faked `docker context show`) so the scope-matched path is
actually exercised.

## Evidence (deterministic before/after)
This is a **timing race** a happy-path lifecycle run cannot reliably trigger, so live host_smoke is
deferred to maintainer CI (as with https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1124). Instead the race is
reproduced **deterministically** with two regression tests that FAIL on base `cf5081fc` and PASS with this
change:

```
# BASE (this change stashed) — the sweep deletes the concurrent same-scope claim:
$ go test -race -run TestCleanupOrphanSweep ./internal/providers/localcontainer/
--- FAIL: TestCleanupOrphanSweepDeletesConcurrentAcquireClaim
    Cleanup's orphan sweep deleted the claim registered by a concurrent same-scope Acquire ... present=false
    remove claim lease=cbx_lcfresh12345 slug=fresh-slug reason=missing container
--- FAIL: TestCleanupOrphanSweepGuardDeclinesReclaimedCandidate
FAIL

# HEAD (this change) — both pass; full package suite green:
$ go test -race ./internal/providers/localcontainer/
ok  github.com/openclaw/crabbox/internal/providers/localcontainer
```

`TestCleanupOrphanSweepDeletesConcurrentAcquireClaim` exercises the reorder (a fresh concurrent claim);
`TestCleanupOrphanSweepGuardDeclinesReclaimedCandidate` exercises the `RemoveLeaseClaimIfUnchanged` guard
(a reclaim mid-cleanup). `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l`, and the full `go test -race ./...`
suite are clean.

## Not included (scope)
apple-container is fixed in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1146; the same class in the `external`
provider is a sibling PR to follow under https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1144. Providers that
already guard the sweep (tart https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1124, aws/azure
https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/446, freestyle/islo https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/781)
or re-check ownership before deleting (multipass/hyperv/kubevirt) are unaffected.
